proposed_option.name: peer_clearance
proposed_option.status: not implemented; metric peer observation prerequisite unresolved

method: observed obstacle footprint padding and swept path checks; never convert missing observations into free space

planning_gate.sigma_rule: largest-axis positional standard deviations; sum is conservative without assuming independent world-frame estimates
planning_gate.footprint: circumscribed radius of the existing [-0.18,0.28] x [-0.18,0.18] m navigation envelope for each robot
planning_gate.missing_peer_position_or_sigma: unknown, not pass; no substitution from setup, trajectory, contacts, or renderer
planning_gate.coverage: whole commanded pulse curve, not endpoints alone; current observation coverage and source provenance required
planning_gate.changed_actions: count and list changes; keep any already-certified safe pulse byte-identical
planning_gate.off: unchanged controller source and byte-identical replay required

pose_report.missing_covariance: report coverage, never drop from denominator silently

physical_order: only after valid replay clearance gate: seed1054 then a preregistered unused seed, agent_lock and ugrp_session, one at a time
new_observation_diagnostic: not authorized by the strict replay-before-physics order; pending user answer to explicit exception request
gt: evaluation only; initial registered peer anchors are not live truth or allowed controller observations
